_description: Clara Answers - Client Onboarding Form. Fill all fields that apply. Leave unknown fields as null or empty string.

call_transfer_rules.on_transfer_fail: Take voicemail and promise callback within 1 hour

emergency_routing_rules.fallback: If all contacts unreachable, advise caller of 15-minute callback and log the call

emergency_definition: gas leak or smell of gas
loss of heat in freezing temperatures
integration_constraints: Do not create jobs in ServiceTrade for non-emergency after-hours calls
All inspection scheduling must go through the office during business hours
special_constraints: All emergency sprinkler calls must go directly to the phone tree without pre-collection
Non-emergency extinguisher service calls can be collected after hours without transfer
Never transfer residential calls - take message only
If transfer fails after configured timeout, dispatch coordinator must be notified

non_emergency_routing_rules.after_hours: Collect name, number, service address, and issue description. Promise next business day callback.
non_emergency_routing_rules.during_hours: Transfer to main office line. If no answer, take message.

notes: Client prefers all voicemails to be emailed to dispatch@acmefire.com. Do not give out technician cell numbers directly.
